title: WabbleSpec Benchmark
description: Schema for a WabbleSpec module improvement benchmark. Every benchmark must link to a real developer failure mode — abstract quality scores are insufficient.

benchmark_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this benchmark run.

module_under_test.description: The WabbleSpec module ID being evaluated (must match a module id in framework.yaml).

type.description: Metric type — prevents mixing incomparable metric classes across benchmarks.

unit.description: Unit of measurement (e.g. percent, milliseconds, count).

developer_outcome.description: The real developer failure mode this benchmark prevents. Required — a benchmark without a developer outcome link is not a valid WabbleSpec benchmark. false_completion: task marked done but was not; missed_test: test coverage gap; stale_evidence: outdated knowledge used; rework: output had to be redone due to module error.

developer_outcome_evidence.description: Pointer to one or more real receipts or execution logs where this failure mode occurred. Required when developer_outcome is set. Format: receipt path or receipt ID.

receipt_ref.description: Path to the WabbleSpec receipt that produced this baseline measurement.

value.description: Target metric value for improvement to be considered valid.

rationale.description: Why this target value was chosen. Must reference developer outcome, not abstract quality preference.

held_out_split.description: Separate held-out evaluation split, never used for tuning. Required to prevent overfitting (backend integrity lesson: 100% on tuned set, 98.4% on held-out).

tuning_cases.description: Cases allowed for tuning/development. Never used to claim benchmark results.

held_out_cases.description: Cases reserved for final evaluation only. This is the number reported.

seed.description: Random seed used for split. Required for reproducibility.

reproducible.description: Reproducibility contract — benchmark must be runnable deterministically from a fixture set.

fixtures_path.description: Path to the fixture set used for evaluation. Fixtures must be committed — no runtime data fetch.

run_command.description: Shell command to reproduce this benchmark exactly.

expected_output_path.description: Path to golden output file for comparison (codeflow golden test pattern).

rejection_criteria.description: Explicit conditions under which this benchmark rejects a proposed module improvement.

condition.description: Measurable condition (e.g. held_out metric regresses below baseline.value).

verdict.description: REJECT: improvement cannot proceed. WARN: flag for human review.

control_arm.description: Required when benchmarking probabilistic or stylistic behavior changes. Isolates the candidate's contribution from effects any terse instruction would produce. Omit for deterministic structural gate changes (file existence, schema field presence).

arm_type.description: terse_instruction: compare against a simple brevity instruction; system_prompt: compare against a minimal system prompt; minimal_spec: compare against a one-sentence spec

arm_description.description: What the control arm actually tested — enough detail to reproduce.

arm_held_out_value.description: The control arm's held-out metric value on the same fixture set.

honest_delta.description: candidate held_out_value minus arm_held_out_value. Positive = candidate outperforms control. Zero or negative = candidate adds no value beyond generic instruction.

axes.description: Named-axis decomposition for composite blueprints. Required when the benchmark metric is a composite score. Omit for atomic/deterministic modules. Each axis defines its weight and how the score was measured.

axis.description: Named axis from the WabbleSpec standard scoring table.

weight.description: Points allocated to this axis out of 100 total.

operationalization.description: How this axis is measured for this specific module. Must reference concrete test fixtures or acceptance criteria.

score_in_calibration_run.description: Axis contribution score in the degradation analysis calibration run. Required when axis_calibration_run is true.

axis_calibration_run.description: True when a degradation analysis has been run per benchmark-discipline Rule 7. Required for composite benchmarks before blueprint gate acceptance.

run_history.description: Ordered list of benchmark runs. Each run records held-out metric only.

held_out_value.description: Metric on held-out split only. Tuning-set values not recorded here.
